title: Marks and patterns
lede: Eight interlaced and knot marks, a kolam line pattern and two checkerboards, in black ink (#1b1916) on a transparent ground. PNGs at 1000px; SVGs where they are small and clean (under 150 KB).

elements.title: Mark 5312
elements.desc: Six looping bands, striped, interlaced around a ring of dots.

elements.title: Mark 795
elements.desc: Six bold loops interlaced around an open hexagon, with three thin inner lines.

elements.title: Mark 3956
elements.desc: Five solid loops woven around a small star-shaped centre.

elements.title: Mark 4672
elements.desc: A circle of fine concentric lines around a woven diamond. PNG only: the fine lines make a heavy trace.

elements.title: Mark 885
elements.desc: Four looped bands woven around a central square.

elements.title: Spiral knot
elements.desc: Four interlocking spiral bands, in even black lines.

elements.title: Wave ring
elements.desc: An eight-lobed ring of wavy bands, enlarged from a small logo.

elements.title: Mark 4779
elements.desc: Radiating wedges spiralling around an open, notched centre.

elements.title: Kolam knot
elements.desc: A looping line woven around a grid of dots, in the manner of a kolam.

elements.title: Checkerboard
elements.desc: Black squares with slightly rounded corners, white made transparent.

elements.title: Checkerboard, 3 rows
elements.desc: A strip of three rows of twelve checks.
